'''Vanjervalis Systems''', or just '''Vanjervalis'''<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 33">[[Knights of the Old Republic 33|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 33]]</ref>, was a manufacturer of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] systems for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. [[Gorman Vandrayk]] worked for Vanjervalis at some point.

==History==
Several years prior to the war, it created the concept of the [[Vanjervalis Chain]], which allowed a group of [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruisers]] to be linked to a single [[Inexpugnable-class tactical command ship|''Inexpugnable''-class tactical command ship]], developed by [[Rendili/Vanjervalis Drive Yards]].

When the [[Jedi Covenant]] leader [[Haazen]] learned of this naval system through the [[Economic Study Circle|Economic WatchCircle]], he used the finances of [[Draay Trust]] to buy the whole company.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 33" /> Then, using the Covenant's influence, he forced the design past the [[Admiralty (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Admiralty]], slipping in an extra feature&mdash;a direct line to himself. This led to a disastrous result during the [[Vindication]], when Haazen revealed himself as a servant of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and forced the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] to fire upon the members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 34" />

Millennia later, by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Vanjervalis shipyards had been incorporated into the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] conglomerate.<ref name="TEGtW" />
